description: Audit a .env file and compare it with an example. Reports a duplicate name, where loaders disagree over which wins; an unquoted value with a trailing comment or space, kept by some loaders and trimmed by others; an interpolation of a name the file does not define, which most loaders substitute as empty so the value is silently incomplete; a required name absent or empty; and a name present in one file and not the other. No value is ever returned. Pay 120000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

env.description: The .env file. Nothing is fetched: no cloud account is contacted and no credential is accepted, so the document supplied is the whole input.
env.example:
# local development
DATABASE_URL=postgres://app@localhost:5432/app
API_BASE=https://${API_HOST}/v1
LOG_LEVEL=debug # verbose for now
GREETING=hello world
SESSION_SECRET=
LOG_LEVEL=info

example.description: An example or template file to compare names against, in both directions.

required.description: Names that must be set to a non-empty value.

name: env_file_contract_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

conformant.description: True only when every required name was set, every reference resolved, and the comparison the caller asked for was performed.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

names.description: The names set. Never the values.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

title: Env File Contract Audit
